selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Living Flame's cast time is reduced by 0.2 sec, and it deals 50% increased damage or healing when it is a non-instant cast.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 扭转天平的冷却时间缩短30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Tip the Scales' cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你激活复制体时，你的黑檀之力额外提供75%的属性。并且会让地壳激变和喷发的伤害提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While your duplicate is active, your Ebon Might grants 75% additional stats and Upheaval and Eruption deal 25% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每当你延长黑檀之力时，你的复制体的持续时间也会延长，延长时间相当于你延长黑檀之力时间的50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Any time you extend Ebon Might, your duplicate is also extended, equal to 50% of the amount you extended Ebon Might by.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 亘古吐息会召唤一个来自未来的你协助战斗，持续20秒。你的复制体会施放喷发、火焰吐息和地壳激变。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Breath of Eons summons a version of you from the future to assist you in battle, lasting 20 sec. Your duplicate casts Eruption, Fire Breath, and Upheaval.
